name: Engineered Equipment Co-Alaska
old_description: The company specializes in the design and manufacturing of power generation systems and automatic transfer switches for low and medium voltage applications.
about:
Engineered Equipment Company was established in Anchorage, Alaska, in 1967 by Richard (Dick) W. Spils, an engineer with Standard Oil who recognized the need for a local representative to serve industrial product manufacturers in the state. The firm has maintained a continuous presence in Alaska since its inception. In 1994, J. Mark Wilson acquired the company and expanded its reach; a second office opened in Bothell, Washington, in 2016 to cover Washington, Oregon, and Idaho.

The company operates as a manufacturer's representative and distributor for brands of electrical equipment, valves, pumps, and process measurement and control instrumentation. With offices in Anchorage and Bothell, it serves industrial and heavy commercial markets across the Northwest, providing technical consulting and application support for complex projects.

Its customer base includes process plants and large-scale commercial installations in sectors such as power generation, water and wastewater treatment, oil and gas, food and beverage, chemical processing, pulp and paper, semiconductor manufacturing, life sciences, higher education, health care, transportation, and infrastructure.

Engineered Equipment emphasizes a consultative approach, positioning itself as a technical resource that helps clients solve challenging applications. The company cites its longevity as Alaska's longest-operating manufacturer's representative for process control and electrical equipment, combined with responsive service and demonstrated technical competence, as the foundation of its client relationships.

name: Engineered Plastic Components
old_description: Leading North American supplier of engineered plastic components for automotive, appliances, medical, and consumer industries
about:
Engineered Plastic Components (EPC Manufacturing) is headquartered in Lebanon, Kentucky, and operates a network of 21 manufacturing facilities across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The company serves as a Tier 1 supplier to automotive OEMs and provides molded components for appliance, medical device, and consumer product manufacturers.

The company specializes in injection molding with press capacities ranging from 25 to 4,400 tons, offering two-shot molding, overmolding, insert molding, gas assist, and in-mold decoration. Secondary operations include sonic, hot plate, spin, and vibration welding; pad printing, silk screening, hot stamping, and heat transfer; as well as interior and exterior painting, powder coating, and full assembly and sub-assembly. Facilities such as the 250,000-square-foot Lebanon, Kentucky plant run 24/7, while the Osceola, Wisconsin site maintains ISO 13485 certification and IQ/OQ/PQ validations for medical device packaging.

EPC supplies complex instrument panel assemblies, center consoles, door panels, and painted exterior trim to automotive manufacturers. For the appliance sector it produces control panels, structural housings, and components with heat resistance and UV stability. Medical customers receive precision housings for diagnostic equipment and surgical instrument components manufactured in FDA-compliant cleanrooms. Consumer product lines include electronic device housings and appliance parts made with recycled materials where specified.

The company emphasizes its North American footprint, 24/7 production capability, and integrated quality systems—including IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 13485 certifications across multiple sites—as key differentiators for supply chain reliability and regulatory compliance.

name: Ennis Fine Furniture- Boise
old_description: Celebrating 80 Years — Ennis Fine Furniture, Family Owned Since 1946
about:
Ennis Fine Furniture was founded in 1946 in Boise, Idaho, when World War II veteran Cecil Ennis and his brother-in-law purchased a former horse stable at 23rd Street and Fairview Avenue and converted it into a furniture and appliance store. The business has remained family-owned for nearly eight decades, passing from Cecil to his son Dick Ennis in 1968 and now to the third generation—grandchildren Rick, Jeff, and Cathy—who continue to operate the company today.

The retailer operates two showrooms, in Boise and Spokane, Washington, offering living-room, bedroom, and dining-room collections that include sofas, sectionals, chairs, tables, beds, dressers, and cabinetry. Ennis Fine Furniture positions itself as a destination for semi-custom and luxury furnishings, providing design consultation to help clients select finishes, stains, and configurations. The company also handles delivery, installation, and haul-away of old furniture.

Its customer base consists primarily of residential homeowners throughout the Pacific Northwest. Testimonials cite purchases ranging from dining tables and floor lamps to complete family-room sets, with clients emphasizing the personalized attention from named design consultants such as John Ambrose, Mary Ann, and Patti.

The company attributes its longevity to its family-legacy values—trust, loyalty, and a personalized experience—rather than mass-market trends. As the ownership states, the goal is not only to provide handcrafted furniture but to ensure every step of the journey is met with care and attention, making the purchase an investment in a piece of history and artistry.

Epic Welding serves industrial and agricultural customers, regularly building trailers, agricultural equipment, and pipe work. The company emphasizes custom, tailor-made fabrication for each job, working with aluminum, stainless steel, and mild steel to meet customer specifications.

The business invites prospective clients to call or visit for a tour to discuss capabilities, positioning itself as a partner that can take projects from prototype design through finished products.

old_description: For over 28 years, Erwin Custom Fabrication has specialized in custom welding and metalwork in Nampa and across Idaho—precision-built for your needs.
about:
Erwin Custom Fabrication operates from Nampa, Idaho, where it was founded in 1993. The shop has served the Treasure Valley for over three decades, building a reputation for custom welding and metalwork across residential, commercial, and industrial projects.

The company provides a full range of fabrication services under one roof, including structural steel fabrication, welding of steel, aluminum, and stainless steel, sheet metal forming, laser cutting, and ornamental metalwork. Its project portfolio spans custom range hoods, gates and fences, metal cabinets, countertops, signage, sinks, wainscoting, stair and railing systems, and steel tanks for industrial use.

Erwin works with homeowners, builders, and commercial contractors throughout the Treasure Valley — including Nampa, Caldwell, Meridian, Boise, and surrounding mountain communities. Its customer base covers residential construction, commercial building, architectural metalwork, and foodservice equipment fabrication.

The shop emphasizes shop capacity over sales rhetoric, highlighting decades of experience, precision craftsmanship with tight fits and clean welds, and local accessibility for dependable communication and handoff.

name: Evans Food Company
old_description: Evans Food Company was founded in 1991 out of a passion for food and an entrepreneurial spirit.
about:
Evans Food Company operates from Springfield, Missouri, where it was founded in 1991 out of a passion for food and an entrepreneurial spirit. The company began as a provider of high-quality food manufacturing for retail packaging and food service production.

Today it functions as a co-pack and private-label manufacturer and food distributor, specializing in sauces, dressings, and side items. Its services span recipe formulation and costing, label design, production runs from small to large batches, climate-controlled warehousing, and digital marketing support. The facility handles both low- and high-volume orders, and the company also markets its own brands, including The Grove Salsa, Hopsing Gourmet Sauces, and Chill CBD Water.

Customers range from startup entrepreneurs to established food businesses seeking co-packing or private-label assistance for products such as salsas, hot sauces, soups, and condiments. The company also partners with the Fight for the Forgotten initiative, directing proceeds from Chill CBD Water sales to clean-water projects in the Congo.

Evans Food Company emphasizes a blend of culinary expertise and business acumen, offering in-house graphic design, a typical lead time of two to three weeks after payment receipt, and a commitment to replicating exact flavors across every batch.

name: EverGreen Treated Wood (DBA Iowa Wood Preservers)
old_description: We offer a diverse line of treatment products that allow us to treat and manufacture lumber products for various uses and applications.
about:
EverGreen Treated Wood, doing business as Iowa Wood Preservers, operates from Oskaloosa, Iowa, with additional facilities in Sutton, Nebraska, and Willmar, Minnesota. The family‑owned company was founded by Vic Sowl, who remains listed as founder, and is now led by his son Nick Sowl as president.

The company pressure‑treats and manufactures lumber products for wholesale distribution across the Midwest. Its treatment lines include CCA for commercial and agricultural use, MCA (Lifewood) for residential exterior applications, and Pyro‑Guard fire‑retardant lumber and plywood for enclosed structural work. Value‑added services include kiln drying after treatment (KDAT), precision end trimming (PET), notched runner fabrication for shed foundations, and V‑groove paneling for agricultural and utility buildings. Three regional plants support wholesale shipments, though total headcount and annual volume are not disclosed.

EverGreen serves agricultural, residential, fire‑protection, government and utility, marine, and wood‑foundation markets. Customers include wholesale lumber yards, builders, and contractors seeking treated framing, decking, guardrail, and foundation materials. The company also supplies marine‑grade plywood and fire‑retardant products for code‑driven projects.

Management emphasizes its family‑owned structure and Midwest footprint as a differentiator, stating that local ownership drives a commitment to durable, cost‑effective wood preservation and responsive customer service.

name: Everlast Energy & Roofing
old_description: Everlast Energy & Roofing was founded in 2022 by stepbrothers Josh Jackson and Alex Ciccio with a simple but powerful mission: to bring honesty, reliability, and long-term value back to homeowners. Both born and raised in Connecticut, they saw families struggling with unreliable contractors, rising homeownership costs, and confusion around energy solutions.
about:
Everlast Energy & Roofing was founded in 2022 in Manchester, Connecticut by stepbrothers Josh Jackson and Alex Ciccio. The pair, both Connecticut natives, started the business from a small basement with a mission to bring honesty and reliability to homeowners facing unreliable contractors and rising energy costs.

The company provides residential and commercial roofing services including roof replacements, repairs, storm damage restoration, and ventilation solutions, alongside solar energy installations, battery storage, EV charger setup, and solar removal/reinstallation. Operating with a team of over 40 professionals, Everlast has completed more than 800 projects and served over 1,200 homeowners across Connecticut.

Everlast serves residential homeowners and commercial property owners throughout Connecticut. Its customer base includes families seeking roof replacements or solar systems to lower energy bills, as well as businesses needing flat-roof systems such as TPO and rubber roofing. The company also partners with the University of Connecticut as the sole solar partner and a vetted roofing provider.

The founders started Everlast after seeing families struggle with untrustworthy contractors and confusion around energy options. The company emphasizes transparent pricing, clear communication, and a 25-year transferable workmanship warranty on roof replacements, aiming to deliver long-term value and peace of mind.
